Container.Name: NetSentry
Container.Overview: Network inventory, CVE matching and log review, summarised by your local Ollama model. Recommendations only: the AI has read-only tools and never changes anything.
Container.Description: NetSentry runs on a schedule: it builds a device and service inventory from your UniFi gateway and nmap, matches service versions to known CVEs, reviews logs from Loki, and asks a local Ollama model to write a prioritised report with evidence and suggested actions. Reports are saved to appdata and can be sent to a webhook (Node-RED, Home Assistant).[br][br]Requires an Ollama instance with a tool-calling model (e.g. qwen3:14b). UniFi and Loki are optional.[br][br]Only scan networks you own or are authorised to test. The nmap vulners script sends detected product/version strings to vulners.com; remove it from nmap_args in config.yaml for offline use.[br][br]On first start a default config.yaml is written to the Config path and the container waits. Edit it, then restart. If other containers use a custom br0 network, enable "Host access to custom networks" in Docker settings.
Container.Requires: An Ollama server reachable from this host.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml lives here. A default is written on first start.

Config.Name: UniFi password
Config.Description: Password for the local view-only UniFi account named in config.yaml. Leave empty if not using UniFi.

Config.Name: Log review schedule
Config.Description: Cron for log-only review, e.g. 15 * * * *. Leave empty unless Loki is configured.

Config.Name: Run on start
Config.Description: true = do one full run whenever the container starts.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules and report names.
